text:
emily_cs: Quick smoke from SylvanCove private deploy this AM. Consolidating outstanding asks so cutover doesn't drift.

nate_customer: Thanks Emily. Primary constraint: compliance requires no KMS rotations during cutover. Can't accept key state changes.

emily_cs: Got it. Raj/Claire please propose a freeze window and update the cutover runbook with an ack step for the customer's security rep.

raj_netops: Proposed KMS freeze: 2026-05-12T20:00Z -> 2026-05-14T08:00Z (36h). Adding explicit ack checkbox to runbook. Nate ok?

nate_customer: Works for us. We'll lock any key rotations in our change control for that window.

claire_sre: Audit logs: customer wants 365-day retention and must use their CMK for S3 encryption. We need the key ARN and a minimal key policy granting redwood-servicerole Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey and CreateGrant for Firehose.

nate_customer: We'll generate a constrained CMK and post ARN + policy snippet by EOD.

emily_cs: Networking: we observed rejected traffic from their egress to our management plane. Need egress CIDR and whether they SNAT. Also confirm ports: runtime 443, provisioning 22/443.

nate_customer: Egress CIDR 10.11.200.0/22. They SNAT via NAT EIPs 18.205.33.12 and 18.205.33.13.

raj_netops: Adding CIDR and EIPs to allowlist. Note: peering requires them to advertise 10.11.200.0/22 in their route table or peering won't forward.

OnboardBot: Checklist: CMK ARN pending, Runbook updated with KMS freeze, Egress CIDR/EIPs added (pending customer confirm), Firehose/S3 config awaiting ARN.

emily_cs: Renewal watch: procurement noted possible quarter-end hold. If cutover slips >8 business days we'll loop in AM. Keep timeline.

nate_customer: Understood. Will post CMK ARN and SIEM endpoint by EOD and confirm route advertisement.

claire_sre: Action items: (1) Raj to confirm peering route propagation (ETA 2h), (2) Nate to post CMK ARN + SIEM ingest info (ETA EOD), (3) Emily to monitor renewal watch and escalate if slip >8bd.

raj_netops: Starting route checks now. Will upload route table screenshots when routes show.

emily_cs: Thanks all 44d next check-in tomorrow 09:00 PT or earlier if something blocks.
